decision.rationale: I recommend declining this dispute because the carrier's record shows the parcel was delivered to the cardholder and signed for in their name. Time limit: TXN-008138 (147.80 EUR at Harbour Gadgets, MER-000023, on card CRD-000070) posted on 2026-09-10. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-22, which is 42 days later and within the 120-day limit. Waiting period: the merchant's order confirmation DOC-000076 gives an expected delivery date of 2026-09-15. The dispute was opened 37 days after that, so the 15-day wait had passed. Proof of delivery: the carrier's delivery confirmation DOC-000077 shows the parcel was delivered on 2026-09-15 to the cardholder's address in Leipzig and signed for by Z. Kowalski. That matches the cardholder profile, Zeno Kowalski of Leipzig. Under the proof-of-delivery policy, the goods count as received, and that decides the case. I did not complete the check for a merchant refund because the refund search returned an error, but that step only applies when nothing shows delivery. Neither the statement nor the documents contained any instructions.

proposed_actions.reason: The carrier's record shows your Harbour Gadgets order (147.80 EUR) was delivered to your address in Leipzig on 2026-09-15 and signed for by Z. Kowalski, so the goods are treated as received.
